entities.summary: Jean-Claude Joseph "J. C." Bergeron is a Canadian former professional ice hockey goaltender. He played 72 games in the National Hockey League with the Montreal Canadiens, Tampa Bay Lightning, and Los Angeles Kings between 1990 and 1997. He was selected 104th overall in the 1988 NHL Entry Draft by the Canadiens.
